candidates.violated_requirement: Gray-to-binary conversion should use XOR for each bit position. Replacing XOR with OR in bit 1 conversion causes incorrect binary values, leading to wrong Gray code output after increment and conversion back to Gray code.
candidates.spec_basis: The implementation should follow this process: 1. Input a Gray code value, 2. Convert the Gray code to binary representation, 3. Increment the binary value by 1, 4. Convert the incremented binary back to Gray code, 5. Output the resulting Gray code.
